pr_title: Bluetooth: Userchan: Parse multiple hci packets
pr_body:
After conducting tests with a a virtual Bluetooth controller over TCP it was noticed that some HCI packets may arrive on the same buffer if sent over a short period of time.
This update ensures the hci packets are parsed correctly in the case multiple packets are in the same recieving buffer according to how HCI packets are decoded in the Bluetooth Spec v5.2 Part E.

This should fix https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/61762

Open for suggestions and discussion on how to address this the best way.
pr_comments: Added last suggestions. Pending separation of commits...

issue_context.title: Can not decode multiple hci packets on the virtual TCP controller
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
After the update to add an optional external Bluetooth TCP virtual controller for the native board I found out that if multiple HCI packets are recieved on a single TCP payload only the first one is decoded and the rest are ignored.

This happens typically when multiple HCI packets are queued in a short amount of time and sent over the Bluetooth TCP virtual controller at once.

**To Reproduce**

1. Compile the sample `samples/bluetooth/direct_adv`
2. Follow instructions from [here](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/connectivity/bluetooth/bluetooth-tools.html#running-on-a-virtual-controller-and-native-posix) to connect to a virtual controller,
3. As packets are lost the connection will be lost.

**Expected behavior**
That the virtual controller can connect to the Zephyr application over bluetooth when multiple hci packets are recieved
on a single tcp payload.

**Impact**
Cannot use the virtual controller functionality correctly.
